alt_text: A woman with her hair in a bun, seen from behind in a dark green shirt, talks with a man in a gray t-shirt beside a whiteboard in a warmly lit indoor workspace, with a plastic cup with a red straw on the table. in Centro Histórico, Mexico City. Text on the image: Find your Business English level in 15 minutes
caption:
Most professionals in Mexico City know their English is "good" or "not bad", but few know where it sits on the CEFR scale. That is the difference between guessing and planning. Our short level test takes about 15 minutes. It is free and online, and you can start without signing up. It looks at grammar, vocabulary and reading, then gives you a CEFR level and clear next steps. If you are thinking about gifts this season, skip the gadgets. A skill outlasts any device, and knowing your starting point is the first step to building it. Once you have your result, a free chat is there to talk it through.
